summary.text: Palo Alto Networks, a cybersecurity company, published a cybersecurity advisory about vulnerabilities in their PAN-OS software. The advisory mentions that Siemens Industrial products, specifically the RUGGEDCOM APE1808, are affected by these vulnerabilities. Customers are advised to review and implement the workarounds provided in the advisory.
